audit.report: During the incident, checkout degraded with 4 timeouts and 55% success, costing about $4,300 per minute. The root blocker (pid 1335190) held locks for 4.2 seconds, blocking 12 sessions. The Database Guardian first proposed to terminate the blocker, then switched to wait after confirming no locks. The Continuity Guardian requested owner input because revenue at risk was $4,293/min and SLO 95% over 10s. The business tolerated up to 60 seconds of degraded checkout.
audit.root_cause: The blocker kept a session locked, causing checkout timeouts and lost revenue.
